protocol.algorithm: full source search every run; cached template/scorer initialization excluded and separately reported
protocol.candidates: current C++ pyramid/NCC generates all seeds; no saved detections or truth positions
protocol.refinement: 6 local grid rounds; float sampling; fixed scale on original images
protocol.continuous: 15 angle/scale proposals (5 fixed-scale or 1 translation-only), preserve original + best, C++ CPU analytic LM; Metal only scores proposals
protocol.continuous_direct: Ablation: identical CPU coarse seeds straight to LM without the additional proposal bank
protocol.accelerated: Same seed policy; Metal analytic derivative statistics and NCC proposals, CPU 4x4 solve and exact final score verification/polish
protocol.fourier: local ROI proposal after CPU coarse search; CPU NumPy FFT; retain seed when proposal invalid or scores worse
protocol.raster: OpenCV used for image decoding and independent controlled-scene generation, not matching
protocol.truth: only controlled scene: <=2px, <=1deg, <=2% scale; original photos only reference agreement
protocol.memory: fresh Python process peak RSS including decoding/setup; scorer buffers separate and overlap shared RAM
